items.notes: FAST Candidate Reviewer re-fetched exact 02f7707f..fd7cb6b range: three implementation commits touch only LocalLlamaProvider, bootstrap wiring, and a fail-closed pinned-source patch script. The patch extends upstream InferenceEngine, adds a JNI reset that refuses missing SYSTEM boundaries, trims template chat history to SYSTEM only, removes KV strictly after system_prompt_position, resets short-term/sampler state, and makes LocalLlamaProvider preserve identity fingerprint only on successful reset. The candidate fixes the previously impossible reset prerequisite only. The new patch script is transitively cache-invalidated now because bootstrap changed; future edits to that script should also update bootstrap or the APK cache key/path list. No hosted CI/APK/device claim was made.

Cross-checks against AiContext, LocalLlamaProvider, the pinned ai_chat.cpp processSystemPrompt/processUserPrompt behavior, Furina's Jinja incremental formatter patch, and the accepted reset primitive show that a second ROLE_SYSTEM incremental decode after the stable system_prompt_position can carry session continuity and be removed by the next reset. Reviewer rejected using processSystemPrompt because it resets long-term state and advances the preserved boundary, and again rejected USER injection because confirmed C2 already identifies role contamination. Risks are explicitly bounded: consecutive SYSTEM template behavior, overflow, partial failure fingerprints, and AAR cache invalidation require implementation/MEDIUM validation. No runtime, CI, APK, latency, persona, or memory-quality improvement is claimed.

items.notes: FAST Candidate Reviewer re-fetched exact 1f4e1cd2..04f8c4d8: two commits modify only LocalLlamaProvider.kt (+41/-8). Provider adds stableIdentityPrefixReady, refuses public reset helper unless the native boundary is known identity-only, uses resetConversationKeepingSystemPrompt only for same-identity ready prefixes, otherwise establishes identitySystemPrompt once and appends sessionRehydrationPrompt as SYSTEM/background, and falls back to coldStartPrompt on append failure. Adversarial review caught a stale-readiness edge on identity rebuild; follow-up 04f8c4d8 now clears readiness before setSystemPrompt(identitySystemPrompt), preventing an old prefix from remaining eligible if prefill fails. Cold model load intentionally remains full coldStartPrompt with readiness=false, so the first later session switch pays one identity-only bootstrap before subsequent fast resets. STATIC review cannot prove patched AAR/Kotlin/C++ compilation or device latency. A local deterministic-gate attempt was unavailable because the execution container could not resolve github.com; this is not counted as green evidence. No hosted CI, APK build, merge, PR or deployment was run.

items.title: Prove turn-scoped SYSTEM background channel without stale retrieval
items.rollbackBoundary: Revert only engineering/diagnosis/turn-scoped-background-channel-20260812-03.md; no runtime/product source changed.
items.expectedMetric: C2 role contamination and stale query-dependent retrieval persistence across local turns
items.expectedDelta: establish a provider-only design that resets each turn to the stable identity prefix, re-appends current session continuity and current turn context as SYSTEM/background, and sends only the literal latest user message as USER
items.verificationWindow: next runtime candidate implements provider-only turn reset/rehydrate semantics; MEDIUM must prove Kotlin/native integration and deterministic gates, followed by BEHAVIORAL/DEVICE checks for role isolation, continuity and latency before product claims
items.notes: FAST Candidate Reviewer re-fetched exact ecd19db1..5a66b27c: one 51-line diagnosis artifact only. Cross-check against LocalLlamaProvider, AiContext and the accepted reset/append primitive shows the existing primitives can avoid both C2 USER contamination and stale SYSTEM retrieval if mutable chat KV is treated as turn-scoped: reset to identity-only before every generation, append refreshed sessionRehydrationPrompt and turnContext as SYSTEM, then send only request.userMessage. Reviewer rejected native middle-KV surgery as unnecessary complexity because it would require deleting a SYSTEM range before newer USER/ASSISTANT KV and repairing positions/template history. Tradeoff is explicit: prior USER/ASSISTANT KV is rebuilt through refreshed summary/recentHistory each turn, so performance must be measured rather than assumed. No runtime/CI/APK/device claim is made.
